canonical_example.text: Ocultó los regalos debajo de la cama.

canonical_example.translation: There's no way to conceal your wrinkles, no matter how much makeup you use.

canonical_example.text: No podremos ocultarles la verdad por mucho tiempo.
canonical_example.translation: We won't be able to hide the truth from them for very long.

canonical_example.text: Se le da muy bien ocultar sus sentimientos.
canonical_example.translation: He's very good at concealing his feelings.
